doc: P2.01 meter arithmetic + P2.22B meter writers. Sources: docs/01_GAME_DESIGN.md §2 (instability ratchet floor = peak - 15; per-turn slow burn +0.35 +0.15*(Fixation/100) -0.2*(Lucidity/100); per day +3; model suggestion caps; the Fixation 'moves by' sources time spent / affection / isolation and the Lucidity sources kindness / honesty / boundaries) and docs/02_DIRECTOR_PROTOCOL.md §1.1 (mood ints -3..3, scaled affection x1.5, trust x2, stress -> instability x0.6). ratchet_drop, slow_burn, daily_burn and mood ARE the design formula: changing one requires a DCR and the doc-value test in tests/test_meters.py, never a quiet tweak. The writers block is the P2.22B magnitudes for the sources docs/01 §2 names but does not number (DCR-1 in production/handoffs/P2.22B.md): time_per_turn + per_affection_gain + isolation feed Fixation, kindness/honesty/boundaries feed Lucidity, keyed by the docs/01 §2 behaviour-profile counters GameState already keeps. Read by game/llm/Meters.gd; the in-code fallback there holds the same values so a broken file degrades to the documented formula.
